title: Implement 60 bosses, seven survivor motion sets, profiles and Windows/LAN playtest
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord now runs sixty boss identities with individual original themes across five modes, seven classes, 378 skills, twenty-eight weapons and six distinct map footprints. The feature branch adds seeded Endless scheduling with repeat protection and an optional Uncounted extension that preserves each player's banked campaign clear.

All seven survivors have independently drawn directional runs, idle, primary attack, hurt, dodge and downed clips. This stage completes Soldier/Medic actions and independent side runs, removes mirrored/static legacy presentation and aligns their body scale. Production libraries contain 1,367 selected poses, with exact original requests, native returns and superseded attempts retained. Independent pixel reconstruction covers every survivor action clip and the new run library; rendered/human/device acceptance remains open.

ProfileV1 persists mastery, rescues, lore, six cosmetic insignia, bests, settings and validated import/export. Personal full-Hard participation gates higher difficulty unlocks without adding permanent combat power. Keyboard/mouse/gamepad mappings, Hold/Toggle actions, touch and fifteen locale catalogs are connected. Boss-history translation remains unfinished. One structured changelog drives the in-game journal, repository and seventeen-page Wiki, now illustrated with seventeen images.

Corrects authored encounter-duration health scaling and friendly projectile damage to Walking District buildings. Numeric spatial queries and construct broad phases preserve same-tick destruction. Evidence includes 210 progression combinations, 2,436 fixture clears, 2,226 restores and 1,740 deployment health/deadline cases. The completed frozen-source one-hour localhost probe maintains fifty active SDK clients and 4,000 hostile projectiles: 108,001 ticks, 21.41 ms p99, 112.11 ms worst and 236 ticks over 33.33 ms. Raw samples, failed setup attempts, frozen bundles and source identities are retained. It uses invulnerable fixture players and zero rendered clients, so normal progression and hosted/WAN/rendered capacity remain separate gates.

Adds 61 audited compressed music deliveries with unchanged WAV fallback and decoded-duration checks. A sandboxed Electron 45 portable app includes offline play, bundled fonts/art/audio and explicit private-IPv4 LAN hosting. Fresh extraction and ordinary Windows copies match every issued package member and pass scoped native fixtures. The public [Windows development download](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/releases/tag/dev-windows-20261024-1) is immutable source 52552c0 and predates these newer action assets.

Authenticated bounded checkpoint compression retains fifty developed builds and 2,400 purchase replies through real HTTP, file-backed process replacement and competing-owner claims. HTTP and expansion bounds stay enforced. Normal public recovery remains disabled; participant credentials, worst-case paging, durable departures and hosted rankings/recovery remain open.

Validation: 320 rules, input, history, profile, WebSocket, HTTP and SQL tests; authored-content/fifteen-locale checks; TypeScript; production build; independent native-art reconstruction; verified public Wiki image bytes. Exact source/build hashes are recorded in reviews/runtime-verification.json. Browser control remains disabled and no new rendered acceptance is claimed.

Keep this PR draft and protected main unchanged. Special-ability/boss animation, final encounter balance, boss-history translation, human listening/playtesting, physical devices/native-language review, hosted rankings/recovery, full progression endurance/capacity and final coordinated release remain incomplete. The public Site still serves its older protocol-4 build.

Fixes survivor frames being limited to twenty-Hz network patches. A bounded drawing clock shows all six short-dodge poses in a sixty-Hz software trace, holds at fifty milliseconds during a stall, ignores duplicates and resets on authority boundaries. Tank Rescue Charge now uses its complete existing ten-tick interval. Both pre-change failures and passing real-input/state-preservation regressions are retained; no rendered-FPS claim is made.

Adds smaller runtime copies for all 168 survivor action/run atlases, preserving all 820 selected poses, world size, origins and timing. Exact decoded RGBA allocation falls from 485,359,616 to 221,347,840 bytes; PNG bytes roughly halve. Independent reconstruction checks every cell, original production hashes stay intact and excluded Engineer frames stay excluded. Two-times display density and matching live-loader contracts are tested. Obsolete survivor preloads are removed; this is not a measured device/GPU-FPS claim.

Loads full boss animations by current encounter through a two-entry cache, with exact same-boss first-frame identities ready during loading/retry. Eight shared actor atlases stay preloaded. The encounter-set decoded-RGBA estimate drops from 306,708,480 bytes to 71,368,704 at startup or at most 80,805,888 with two full atlases. Tests cover every deferred boss, coalescing, retries, shutdown and sprite release before texture destruction. Pixel reconstruction proves all 57 identity crops; rendered slow-network/device acceptance remains open.
